name: tui-terminal-engineering
description: Provides engineering patterns for interactive terminal applications (TUIs), command-line wizards, and terminal emulators using MVU architecture (Charm.sh Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss, Bubbles, Huh) and equivalents in Python and Rust. Use when designing terminal layouts, handling ANSI escape sequences, managing screen resize breakpoints, or building multi-step interactive CLI forms.
